items.summary: Ensure uploaded/published media is visible in both the app's preview experience and the live/production experience: Hero background, all Image Memory slots, all Video Memory slots, and the background song must render using the current MediaStore state and must correctly fall back to backend-published media when local IndexedDB media is absent.

Add an explicit, user-friendly pre-publish preview inside the Media Manager that lets the user confirm what they uploaded for Hero, Images, Videos, and Song before publishing, and make sure the preview uses the staged draft values (not only the currently published/live values).

Fix background audio playback so the user can reliably hear the song in both preview and live/production modes, including when the user uploads a custom song; ensure playback works across common mobile browsers where autoplay may be blocked.
Update the Hero section Media entry-point button to remove the confusing "Edit" label and show a clear, consistent label in English on all screen sizes (keep the icon).

Ensure 'clear' actions are easy to understand and reliably remove media references so the UI falls back to placeholders (Hero, individual image slots, individual video slots, and song) in both preview and live views after Submit.
